replies.text: Credential vaults are the part I would read first. Agent deployments make me nervous once real secrets are in play.
A canvas that an agent creates through a plugin is the one I did not see coming. Curious how that feels in use.
Diff sheets on every tool call is the part that would make me trust this from a phone. The rest is a nice bonus.
Merging to a shared branch. I can read a diff before it lands, but I cannot un-merge something others already pulled.
